_comment: Effects the sheet applies automatically but 5e-tools stores only as prose. Keyed by entry name; applies to feats and to fighting-style options during conversion. Add your own. Effect targets: ac, init, speed, hp.max, profBonus, attack, attack.melee, attack.ranged, damage, damage.melee, damage.ranged, ability.<abbr>, save.<abbr>, skill.<key>. You can also grant proficiencies with "skills": ["Perception"] or "saves": ["wis"].
